description: Returns posted shelf prices from the free UK daily 212-item basket (CC BY 4.0) for up to 20 barcodes (EAN) or retailer product ids, up to one row per retailer for one day: price, was-price, loyalty price, unit price, pack size and stock. Use it for "what did this barcode cost at Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda or Aldi on a day". Each result row lists its barcodes in `ean`. Static snapshot days, not live. Not for searching by product name; only the 212 basket products are covered.

date.description: Day, e.g. "2026-10-08". Omit for the latest day loaded.

eans.description: Barcodes, 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, e.g. ["5000157024671"]. Give eans, products or both.

retailers.description: Only these retailers, e.g. ["tesco", "asda"]. Omit for all four. The basket holds no barcodes for Aldi: use products for Aldi.

name: lookup_basket_prices
title: Daily basket prices by barcode or product id
